# Dispatch F: actual native Agent acceptance

The fixed F controller is available only in a marked, isolated headless process with the existing offscreen and zero-input guards. It accepts no arbitrary renderer source, host method or test task text from parent IPC. Ordinary launches register no F listener.

The author's request enters through the real renderer preload `agentPrompt` channel. The production Electron handler and Rust host own session, user message, turn and world binding; the pi sidecar authors resources using real registered tools. A test helper may not manually write the author's draft or fabricate a host turn and call that an Agent acceptance.

Two fixed E2E scenarios are provided: a tree authored and reviewed by the configured real DeepSeek model, and one task that invokes real `new_context` three times between four edits. Both require actual machine verification, real review, player-form application, complete native process restart and retained world source. Read-only auditing checks the durable source and budget instead of accepting assistant claims.

Native tests remain opt-in. The dispatch authorization covers only isolated offscreen testing, never visible windows, mouse/keyboard events, pointer lock, focus, personal profiles or a user's active browser. Clean Windows installation and visible composition remain separately recorded manual/environment gates.
